title: My cart still has the mug after I placed the order

report.text:
My cart still has the mug after I placed the order

Hi,

I bought an Ash Glaze Mug: added it to the cart, checked out and got the "Thank you" page. But the cart icon at the top still shows 1, and when I open the cart the mug is still in it, so it looks like I could accidentally order it twice.

I expected the cart to be empty once the order went through.

Thanks,
Maya

reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page heading is "Your cart" and the page says "Your cart is empty.""

verdict.title: Empty-cart checkpoint ran with Ash Glaze Mug still in cart
verdict.oneLiner: The empty-cart check ran while the cart still contained one Ash Glaze Mug.
verdict.rootCause: The run reached the cart page without first removing the mug or resetting the cart. The page was in a populated-cart state, so it could not show the empty-cart message.
verdict.suggestion: Reset the cart or remove all items before the checkpoint, then verify the cart badge is 0 before asserting the empty-cart heading and message.

confirmedBy.kane: The empty-cart check ran while the cart still contained one Ash Glaze Mug.

attempts.agentSummary: The cause was in `POST /api/orders` in `server.js`. It saved the order but never emptied the session's cart. The cart page and the header count kept showing the mug after the "Thank you" page. I added `cartFor(sid).clear()` right after the order is stored, so the cart is empty once an order succeeds. I haven't run the app or the flow, as instructed.
